subject: Question about Tysonir's mosquito lamp supply chain
body:
Hi,

I am a big fan of Tysonir's high-voltage designs on Amazon.

I am reaching out because we are a direct factory specialized in Solar Mosquito Killer Lamps (established in 2020). Many of our current Amazon partners have seen a 30% increase in seasonal sales by adding our "Zero Electricity Cost" solar models to their listings.

We handle the R&D and manufacturing, allowing you to focus on the brand growth.

Are you looking for new solar-powered SKUs to boost your 2026 Prime Day performance?

Best,

[My Name]
XPES Factory Team
